يَوْمُ is the predicate of هَٰذَا.
يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ specifies the kind of يَوْمُ.
ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ is the accusative object of يَنفَعُ.
صِدْقُهُمْ is the nominative subject of يَنفَعُ.
هُمْ is governed by لَ as the fronted possession predicate for جَنَّٰتٌ.
لَهُمْ predicates allocation of جَنَّٰتٌ to them.
تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ describes جَنَّٰتٌ.
تَحْتِهَا is governed by مِنْ as the source complement of تَجْرِى.
ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ is the explicit subject of تَجْرِى.
خَٰلِدِينَ is a حال for the people referred to in لَهُمْ.
The pronoun in فِيهَآ marks where خَٰلِدِينَ abide.
أَبَدًا gives the duration of خَٰلِدِينَ.
ٱللَّهُ is the subject of رَّضِىَ.
The pronoun in عَنْهُمْ is governed by عَن as complement of رَّضِىَ.
وَرَضُوا is coordinated with رَّضِىَ.
The pronoun in عَنْهُ is governed by عَن as complement of رَضُوا.
ٱلْفَوْزُ is the predicate of ذَٰلِكَ.
ٱلْعَظِيمُ modifies ٱلْفَوْزُ.
لَّهِ is governed by لِ as the fronted possession predicate for مُلْكُ.
لِلَّهِ predicates ownership of مُلْكُ.
ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ is the genitive complement of مُلْكُ.
وَٱلْأَرْضِ is coordinated with ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ under the construct مُلْكُ.
وَمَا extends the coordinated scope beyond ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ.
The pronoun in فِيهِنَّ is governed by فِي as the predicate of relative مَا.
فِيهِنَّ predicates containment for مَا.
قَدِيرٌ is the predicate of هُوَ.
كُلِّ is governed by عَلَى as the scope complement of قَدِيرٌ.
شَىْءٍ is the genitive complement of كُلِّ.
